messages:
jamie: Heads up — NVIDIA published a security advisory impacting 535.x drivers (privilege escalation) and there's a related cuDNN / NCCL compatibility note. We need triage, patch prioritization, and a compat plan for Hosted / Dedicated / Private clusters. Who can take this?

arjun: I can own triage. What's the suggested timeline and priority?

jamie: Ideally get a hotpatch into staging this week and a canary in prod next week. Note: Private deployments require KMS-signed driver bundles. Also double-check RBAC for deploy-runner to avoid unauthorized artifact signing.

sasha: I'll own the compatibility matrix. Quick question: what CUDA baseline are we validating? Hosted is mostly CUDA 11.8, Dedicated pools are 12.2.

sasha: Plan: run driver vs CUDA/cuDNN/NCCL matrix using a k8s job + microbench. Example job for smoke checks:
```yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: gpu-compat-smoke
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: smoke
        image: redwood/gpu-smoke:latest
        env:
        - name: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
          value: "0"
        command: ["bash","-lc","python -c 'import torch;print(torch.cuda.is_available());print(torch.version.cuda);'"]
      restartPolicy: Never
```
arjun: Add checks to the job for `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version,gpu_name --format=csv` and `ldconfig -p | grep libcudnn` so we capture runtime links.
maria: On KMS/signing: two questions — 1) Do we rotate signing keys for this release? 2) Will Private customers be allowed to opt-out of our signed artifacts and use their own signature? We need key_id in the artifact manifest.

leo: For RBAC, propose a new role `artifact-signer` with least privilege (only kms:Sign + storage read) and ensure it's audited. Example policy snippet:
```json
{
  "role": "artifact-signer",
  "permissions": ["kms:Sign", "storage:GetObject", "storage:ListBucket"],
  "resources": ["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-artifacts/*"]
}
```

jamie: We also need audit logging on all sign operations and an alert if signing volume spikes unexpectedly. Wire Splunk alert to oncall.

devops-bot: deploy pipeline triggered: gpu-compat-smoke/test-runner started by @sasha

sasha: Smoke run (local staging) results: `torch.cuda` True, CUDA 12.2, driver 535.15, cuDNN 9.1.1 detected. Observed small mem leak in cuDNN conv microbench — filing ticket ENG-5042.
arjun: Triage notes: exploitation requires local container privileges plus access to load kernel modules. Priority = P2 for Hosted (because we isolate containers) and P1 for Dedicated/Private (higher blast radius). Recommend backport driver 535.16 with security patches, then canary.
maria: KMS plan: we can sign bundles with key-v2 and rotate on schedule. For Private installs using customer-managed KMS we can accept their signatures OR provide our signed manifest if they opt in. I'll update runbook and add key_id to manifests.

leo: Canary rollout proposal: 10% of Dedicated capacity in us-west, run 48h perf and stability checks. Auto-rollback triggers: error rate >1% or latency >2x baseline. Also expose a fallback path to CPU runtime for critical token flows.
sasha: Need to validate NCCL upgrade — some ABI changes reported. Will run multi-node all-reduce tests. Quick script: 
```bash
# run on 4 nodes
mpirun -np 4 python nccl_test.py --size 1GB
```

jamie: Ops patch window proposed: Sat 2025-07-12 02:00-06:00 UTC. Engineering leads vote?
arjun: +1
sasha: +1 but ask for an extra day to finish NCCL multi-node tests
maria: +0 prefer Sun but can do Sat if we stagger canary timing
leo: +1
jamie: OK hold to Sat, but stagger rollout: staging -> canary (10%) -> remaining after 48h if green.
sasha: Post-deploy checklist: run `nvidia-smi`, `nvcc --version`, quick PyTorch test harness, nccl allreduce, and kube node GPU readiness. I'll add these to CI so we gate the rollout.
jamie: Owners: arjun = triage & patch backport, sasha = compat suite & CI tests, maria = KMS signing & manifests, leo = RBAC + rollout automation, jamie = runbook + external comms. I'll open the runbook PR and cross-ref the incident.
devops-bot: incident created: INC-8421 GPU driver CVE triage (owner: arjun)
maria: Example audit query to detect anomalous sign attempts:
`index=kms_sign source=kms_sign | stats count by key_id, user | where count>10`
sasha: Add canary alerts: perf-regression >=5% or GPU OOMs >3 in 1h should trigger rollback.
jamie: Thanks — sync tomorrow in #eng-releases 10am PT to confirm gating. :thumbsup:
